method: Verified SHA256 archive and member; ordered timestamp rows; split at every non-60-second interval; strict lag60 pairs require 60 consecutive one-minute steps; cross-day if endpoints have different calendar dates. Each later-day row with a cross-day lag requires previous-day context if used as a 60-minute lag feature.
limitation: Counts identify possible temporal feature leakage under calendar-day partitioning; they do not demonstrate model actually used lag60, train/test membership, shared physical exposure, independent group counts, calibration, or G2/G3 qualification.
